schools.name: The Royal Liberty School
schools.inspectionPrecis: There has been no change to this school’s overall judgement of good as a result of this ungraded (section 8) inspection. However, the evidence gathered suggests that the inspection grade might be outstanding if a graded (section 5) inspection were carried out now. The school’s next inspection will be a graded inspection. The headteacher of this school is Lee Raftery. This school is part of Success For All Educational Trust, which means other people in the trust also have responsibility for running the school. The trust is run by the chief executive officer (CEO), Paul Ward, and overseen by a board of trustees, chaired by Neil Yeomans.
